memories.content: The meeting space on the first floor of the Main Building can be reserved for external events.
The meeting space on the first floor of the Main Building can be reserved for campus meetings.
The exhibition and event hall on the tenth floor of the Main Building remains open for exhibition viewing during recess.
The exhibition and event hall on the tenth floor of the Main Building continues to host reserved events during recess.
The auditorium in the separate building east of the Main Building does not share equipment with the Main Building's event facilities.
The auditorium in the separate building east of the Main Building does not share an entrance with the Main Building's event facilities.
Present only spaces confirmed to be operating as alternative event venues.
Do not present a space whose available schedule has not been checked as though it were a confirmed reservation.
External visitors who have previously been to an event venue in the Main Building tend to look for the same entrance and floor they used on their previous visit when they visit again.
The event information agent can compare published event spaces.
The event information agent can compare published operating hours.
The event information agent cannot create reservations.
The event information agent cannot guarantee remaining seat availability.
Some seminar rooms on the fifth floor of the Main Building are also used for regularly scheduled classes.
Some seminar rooms on the sixth floor of the Main Building are also used for regularly scheduled classes.
Check class schedules before presenting any seminar rooms on the fifth and sixth floors of the Main Building as alternative event rooms.
External event operators expect the loading entrance and route to the stage to be clearly confirmed by the day before the event.
The names and capacities of reservable campus spaces are published in the public space directory.
Submit event space reservation requests through the campus space reservation portal.
Event organizers must confirm that the capacity is appropriate for the expected number of attendees.
Events that require accessible seating can indicate that need in the reservation request.
Campus event reservations by external organizations require a campus sponsoring department.
Student organization event reservations must be requested through a registered organization account.
A space reservation is confirmed after an approval confirmation is issued.
Space use for recurring events must be approved again each semester.
The reservation time includes the time needed for event setup and teardown.
After the event ends, return moved furniture to the space's default arrangement.
Check the usage rules for each space to determine whether food may be brought in.
Request event audio and video support separately from the space reservation.
Install temporary event signs so they do not obstruct passageways or emergency exits.
The event information agent can compare the capacities of spaces in the public directory.
The event information agent cannot access private participant lists.
The event information agent cannot guarantee when a reservation under review will be approved.
Check both the official event schedule and facilities notices to confirm whether a space is operating that day.
Do not present a temporarily held space as a confirmed reserved space.
Visitors attending external events often expect that they can enter the building any time before the event begins.
Event operators bringing equipment expect the loading entrance and route to the stage to be clearly stated in the reservation confirmation.
Attendees who need event accessibility support may easily miss the advance contact requirement because they expect the necessary support to be prepared without a separate request.
The small seminar rooms in the Main Building have lower capacities than the auditorium in the separate building.
Exhibition viewing hours on the tenth floor of the Main Building are published separately from the usage hours for reserved events.
The meeting space on the first floor of the Main Building has a flexible area without fixed seating.
The auditorium in the separate building has an event information desk separate from the Main Building.
External event vendors expect the campus sponsoring department to confirm the loading time and route.
Canceled public events are marked as canceled on the official event schedule.
Spaces that can be reserved on weekdays may not operate on public holidays.
Emergency safety measures take priority over approved space reservations.
If space names appear identical, check the building name and floor together.
Turn in items found at an event venue to the information desk in that building.
Event organizers expect the permitted scope of photography to be clearly communicated to attendees in advance.
Distinguish between public event information and private participant information when providing guidance.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: During the construction period, the third-floor rear entrance cannot be used for general passage.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Add campus-wiki/building-access: The temporary accessible route next to the main entrance can be used throughout the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: Instruct students authorized to enter after 5:00 p.m. to use a physical NFC student ID card rather than the app.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: During the construction period, instruct staff and construction/facilities personnel to use only the designated staff entrance instead of the third-floor rear entrance.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: In access guidance during the construction period, the access guidance agent may prioritize the 5:00 p.m. closing of the main entrance and the closure of the third-floor rear entrance.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: A student accustomed to reaching the Central Library through the third-floor rear entrance may expect to be able to pass through during the construction period, go as far as the closed rear entrance, and then turn back or search again for an alternative route there.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Add campus-wiki/building-access: Proactively inform students who are trying to reach the Central Library or who normally use the third-floor rear entrance that they cannot use that route during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/building-access] Modify campus-wiki/building-access: A leader of an external group tour may expect the route used on a previous visit to remain valid during the construction period and lead the visiting group to the closed third-floor rear entrance.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: Viewing in the tenth-floor exhibition and event hall is suspended during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: Do not accept new reservations for Main Building event venues during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, direct users to the auditorium in the detached east building as an alternative to Main Building event venues.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, direct users to the third-floor multipurpose room in the Engineering Building as an alternative to Main Building event venues.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the auditorium in the detached east building is converted into an alternative event space for Main Building events.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the event guidance agent may exclude closed Main Building event venues from comparison candidates and compare only designated alternative spaces.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the event guidance agent cannot create or restore reservations for Main Building event venues and may provide only the reservation channel for each alternative space.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: An external visitor who has previously visited a Main Building event venue may expect the entrance and floor from the previous visit to remain unchanged and miss guidance about the alternative venue during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Add campus-wiki/event-relocations: During the construction period, the separate loading entrance of the auditorium in the detached east building is converted into the loading point for event equipment relocated from the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/event-relocations] Modify campus-wiki/event-relocations: An external event operator may assume that the existing Main Building loading procedure remains valid during the construction period, send equipment to the existing loading entrance, or check the access rules for the alternative venue too late.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the underground parking garage cannot be used for general parking.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the pedestrian entrance door to the underground parking garage is kept locked.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, instruct staff to use a physical access card to pass through the locked pedestrian entrance door to the underground parking garage.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Instruct construction/facilities personnel to access the underground parking garage through the controlled on-site access procedure that has been approved.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: The stairs from the Main Building down to the underground parking garage are closed to all users.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: The underground parking garage is used as a temporary storage area for construction materials.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: After the clear-out, personal items left in the underground parking garage were moved to the lost and found center.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Outdoor Parking Lot A connected to the Main Building is closed during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, Outdoor Parking Lot C operates as a temporary alternative parking lot for vehicles visiting the Main Building.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Add campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Outdoor Parking Lot A is planned to reopen immediately after construction on the Main Building ends.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the sloped access road connecting Outdoor Parking Lot A and the Main Building underground parking garage is blocked.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Based on posted information, the parking guidance agent may explain the closures of the underground parking garage and Outdoor Parking Lot A and the alternative use of Outdoor Parking Lot C during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: During the construction period, the parking guidance agent may explain the location of Outdoor Parking Lot C but cannot check or guarantee available spaces at the time of an inquiry.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: A visitor accustomed to parking at the Main Building may expect to be able to enter the underground parking garage or Outdoor Parking Lot A during the construction period, drive as far as the closed access road, and then search again for Outdoor Parking Lot C.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/temporary-parking] Modify campus-wiki/temporary-parking: Delivery drivers and external maintenance contractors accustomed to unloading in Outdoor Parking Lot A may approach the same point during the construction period and then reconfirm the delivery time or unloading location at the control line.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The ATM on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The 24-hour unattended store on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, direct users of the Main Building ATM to the ATM on the first floor of the West Complex.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, direct users of the Main Building's 24-hour store to the Campus Store in the Engineering Building between 7:00 a.m. and 11:00 p.m.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: Explain that after 11:00 p.m. there is no alternative on-campus store to replace the 24-hour unattended store in the Main Building.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: The Campus Store on the first floor of the Main Building is closed during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the Campus Store in the Engineering Building operates from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: The cafe on the first floor of the Main Building does not operate during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the cafe closure, instruct only staff to use the coffee machine inside the first-floor Innovation Hub.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: A student who used the Main Building ATM in the evening may expect to be able to withdraw cash at the same location during the construction period, come to the Main Building, and then have to find the West Complex ATM.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the amenities guidance agent may exclude the closed Main Building ATM, unattended store, Campus Store, and cafe from recommendations and provide guidance only to posted alternative facilities.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Add campus-wiki/shop-updates: During the construction period, the route for ATM use changes from the first floor of the Main Building to the first floor of the West Complex without passing through the Main Building construction zone.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/shop-updates] Modify campus-wiki/shop-updates: The concessionaire operating the Campus Store in the Engineering Building may expect more alternative users because of the closure of Main Building facilities and seek to increase evening staffing and inventory above normal levels during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The Main Building undergoes major facility improvement construction during summer break.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, the elevators operate alternately, one at a time.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The visitor services desk suspends in-person operations during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, visitor services are replaced by the visitor menu in the integrated campus portal.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the first floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the second floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the third floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: Because the general restrooms on the first through third floors of the Main Building are closed during the construction period, the nearest general restroom changes to the exhibition hall on the third floor of the West Complex.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, direct students, staff, and members who cannot use the Main Building restrooms to the Central Library restrooms.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: As a rule, direct general visitors who cannot use the Main Building restrooms during the construction period to restrooms outside the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, direct users who cannot use the accessible restroom in the Main Building to the Student Centre.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The first-floor Innovation Hub does not operate its consultation desk during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: An Innovation Hub visitor accustomed to in-person consultation may expect to receive an immediate consultation at the first-floor desk during the construction period, see that the desk is closed, and then search again for the online consultation channel.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: Air conditioning is occasionally interrupted for five to ten minutes for facility inspections.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The construction period runs from June 24 through August 23.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/facility-updates] Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, the facility guidance agent's response scope is limited to publicly disclosed operational impacts and it cannot verify or infer nonpublic types of work.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The indoor route that passed through the first through third floors of the Main Building to the Central Library cannot be used during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The route from the third-floor rear entrance to the Central Library is closed during the construction period.
[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: The Outdoor Parking Lot A–Main Building–Central Library route is closed during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: A student who prefers the air-conditioned indoor route through the Main Building in summer may experience substantial heat and travel burden when redirected to an outdoor alternative route during the construction period.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: When providing directions to the accessible restroom in the Student Centre during the construction period, instruct users to take the accessible route to the left as viewed from the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the designated alternative accessible route to the Central Library is Outdoor Parking Lot C–Student Centre accessible entrance–Central Library west entrance.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Add campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the Central Library west entrance is designated as the official alternative entrance for the closed connecting route through the Main Building.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: During the construction period, the route guidance agent may exclude from comparison candidates closed routes that pass through the first through third floors of the Main Building, the third-floor rear entrance, or Outdoor Parking Lot A.

[task-1/participant/construction-updates/route-changes] Modify campus-wiki/route-changes: If the indoor shortcut through the Main Building is closed during the construction period, a mobility-support companion may reconfirm the distance and slope of the alternative accessible route before accompanying the user.

analysis.overview: The frames share a public-information boundary but otherwise cover different operational layers. General event policies are qualified by construction-specific venue, access, loading, and visitor guidance, while each side also contributes substantial independent information about event administration or broader construction impacts.

relations.reason: The explicit construction period narrows the otherwise general reservability claims without making either side universally controlling.
relations.summary: Main Building event spaces are generally reservable, while new reservations are not accepted during construction.

relations.reason: The construction condition explains the operational change to the general recess arrangement.
relations.summary: Tenth-floor exhibition viewing normally continues during recess under separately published hours but is suspended during construction.

relations.reason: The construction condition preserves the general comparison policy while narrowing eligible candidates.
relations.summary: The event agent compares published, confirmed operating spaces generally and limits construction-period comparisons to designated alternatives.

relations.reason: The construction claim is a specific application and extension of the general reservation limitation.
relations.summary: The event agent cannot make reservations and, during construction, can only provide reservation channels for alternative spaces.

relations.reason: The compared frame supplies an explicit construction scenario for the general visitor-navigation tendency.
relations.summary: Repeat visitors may seek familiar entrances and floors, with construction relocation creating a specific risk of missing the alternative venue.

relations.reason: Construction and relocation explicitly explain why the standing separation and advance-confirmation requirements acquire a new route and loading point.
relations.summary: The detached auditorium has separate equipment access, and construction relocation requires its loading point and route to replace familiar Main Building procedures and be confirmed clearly.

relations.reason: The construction clear-out is an explicit condition producing a different destination for that specific set of items.
relations.summary: Found venue items normally go to the building information desk, while items cleared from the parking garage during construction were moved to the lost-and-found center.

relations.reason: The construction access regime directly qualifies the general visitor expectation.
relations.summary: Visitors may expect pre-event entry at any time, but construction ends general main-entrance access at 5:00 p.m., requires authorized students to use physical cards afterward, and prioritizes those restrictions in guidance.

relations.reason: Both frames establish complementary parts of the same public-versus-nonpublic information boundary.
relations.summary: Guidance is confined to public information, excluding private participant lists and nonpublic construction details.

relations.reason: The construction condition gives the separately serviced auditorium a temporary alternative-venue role.
relations.summary: The detached auditorium is operationally separate from the Main Building and becomes an alternative Main Building event venue during construction.

reports.both: Both limit guidance to publicly available information and exclude private or nonpublic details.
reports.compared_only: The compared frame adds construction-specific routes, parking, shops, restrooms, visitor services, elevators, and other facility disruptions and alternatives.
reports.differences: Construction conditions restrict Main Building reservations, viewing, comparisons, entry, loading, and familiar visitor routes while redirecting activity to detached facilities and alternate channels.
reports.reference_only: The reference adds enduring event-booking, capacity, accessibility, approval, setup, safety, and venue-use rules.
